seo.title: Thank you: estimate answers received
seo.description: Your cost estimate answers have reached Calwebtech. Here is what we do with them and what happens next.

title: Thanks. Your estimate answers are with us.
intro: We have your answers about timeline, page count, content, integrations and support. They are stored with your enquiry, so nobody asks you the same questions twice.

steps.title: A person checks the range
steps.body: We read your answers against projects of a similar shape and note anything that would move the number.

steps.title: We email you within one business day
steps.body: You hear the likely band for your project and the decisions that affect it most.

steps.title: A call if you want one
steps.body: If the range works for you, a thirty minute call turns it into a written, fixed proposal.

secondary.heading: Understand the number
secondary.body: See what moves a website quote up or down, and what every project includes as standard.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
